points: Your site shows 800,000 happy customers, yet 0 of 30 ads carry that number, so new buyers never see the scale. Put 800,000 on the creative and in line one, and open two ads with a review quote.
Your site offers 20% off a first order, yet 0 of 30 ads mention it, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Put that offer in line one of three new ads and on the creative.
15 of 30 ads open on the units sold claim, so new buyers hear one pitch. Name 2 or 3 new angles, such as cravings, workout energy and beauty benefits, and run each against it.

Your site lists free shipping over $75, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so new buyers hesitate before clicking. Answer it in the first line of ads for new buyers, stating free shipping over $75 plainly.
